quotes.text: There's a progress bar, so at least I know how long it'll be.

The little folder icon, I get it, it works like a folder.
Why is 'Confirm' before 'Review'? I'd expect to review first.
There's a clear 'cancel' so I can bail out, good.
I'm stuck in this wizard, there's no way out except closing the tab.
I deleted it by mistake but there's an undo, phew.
On this page the button's on the left, on the other page it's on the right.
Every other app puts settings under the gear, this one hides it in 'More'.

I'm scared to press this in case it charges me.

All the options are right there on the screen, I don't have to remember anything.

Nice, it remembered my address, I don't have to type it again.

Doing this one at a time for two hundred items is killing me.
I'd like to hide the panels I never use.

Everything is shouting at me, nothing stands out.
